post.summary: Ingest Raw HL7 v2.x ORU^R01 Message
post.description:
Accepts a raw HL7 v2.x ORU^R01 message (text/plain body). Parses OBX segments, applies DSP artifact rejection, calculates NEWS2 score, and returns a FHIR R4 Bundle.

**Patient ID** is extracted from PID-3 of the HL7 message.

**SpO2 Scale:** Set `spo2_scale=SCALE_2` **only** for patients with confirmed hypercapnic respiratory failure (COPD type 2). Default is SCALE_1 for all other patients.

schema.description: SpO2 scoring scale. SCALE_1 (default) = all patients. SCALE_2 = confirmed hypercapnic respiratory failure ONLY. ISO 14971 HAZARD-SPO2-001.

Accepts a structured JSON payload of vital sign observations. Applies DSP artifact rejection, calculates NEWS2 score, and returns a FHIR R4 Bundle.

Use this endpoint when the upstream system can produce normalized data directly (no HL7 parsing required). For raw HL7 v2.x messages, use `POST /api/v1/ingest` instead.

get.description: Returns every registered Subscription as a FHIR R4 searchset Bundle. No FHIR search parameters are implemented in this pass -- this always returns the full set (single-tenant appliance assumption; see infrastructure/fhir/subscription.py HAZARD-FHIR-004).

AVPULevel.title: AVPULevel
AVPULevel.description:
AVPU Scale â€” Level of Consciousness.

RCP NEWS2 2017: Any deviation from Alert â€” including new confusion (C) â€”
scores 3 points regardless of cause.
ISO 14971 HAZARD-CON-001: Incorrect AVPU assignment causes NEWS2
underestimation. Mitigation: explicit enum prevents free-text encoding.

MonitorVendor.title: MonitorVendor
MonitorVendor.description:
ICU monitor vendors whose HL7 v2.x dialects are explicitly supported.

IEC 62304: SOUP declaration â€” each vendor produces HL7 v2.x with
non-standard extensions. Parser behavior varies per vendor.
ISO 14971 HAZARD-PROTO-001: Unknown vendor â†’ GENERIC fallback parser;
non-standard OBX segments may be silently dropped.

SpO2Scale.title: SpO2Scale
SpO2Scale.description:
NEWS2 defines two mutually exclusive SpO2 scoring scales.

RCP NEWS2 2017 Â§2.4: Scale 2 MUST only be used for patients with a confirmed
diagnosis of hypercapnic respiratory failure (e.g., COPD type 2).
A clinician must explicitly assign Scale 2 â€” it must NEVER be inferred
from SpO2 values alone.

ISO 14971 HAZARD-SPO2-001: Incorrect scale assignment is a patient safety
defect. Default is SCALE_1 to ensure conservative (higher) scoring.

value.title: Value
value.description: Numeric measurement value. For CONSCIOUSNESS type, set avpu_level instead â€” value is ignored.

timestamp.title: Timestamp
timestamp.description: ISO 8601 timestamp WITH timezone (e.g., '2024-01-15T10:00:00Z'). Naive timestamps are rejected. ISO 14971 HAZARD-TIME-001.

avpu_level.description: Required when vital_sign_type is CONSCIOUSNESS. ISO 14971 HAZARD-CON-001: missing AVPU causes consciousness underestimation.

waveform.title: Waveform
waveform.description: Optional raw waveform samples for DSP processing.

sampling_rate_hz.title: Sampling Rate Hz
sampling_rate_hz.description: Required when waveform is provided. Must be > 0.

device_id.title: Device Id
device_id.description: FHIR Device logical ID for this sample's source device.

VitalSignPayload.title: VitalSignPayload
VitalSignPayload.description:
Single vital sign observation from a structured JSON source.

IEC 62304 REQ-API-010: Pydantic validates types and formats before domain
code executes â€” the domain layer receives only well-formed inputs.

VitalSignType.title: VitalSignType
VitalSignType.description:
NEWS2-aligned vital sign identifiers.

IEC 62304 REQ-VITAL-001: Each value maps to exactly one NEWS2 component
in the RCP 2017 clinical algorithm (ISBN 978-1-86016-693-6).
Adding a new value here requires a corresponding NEWS2Calculator update
and a new traceability entry in regulatory/risk_register.xlsx.

VitalSignUnit.title: VitalSignUnit
VitalSignUnit.description: Clinical and SI units for FHIR UCUM encoding.

patient_id.title: Patient Id
patient_id.description: FHIR Patient logical ID. Required for all FHIR resource references.

samples.title: Samples
samples.description: One or more vital sign observations. At least one is required.

spo2_scale.description: SpO2 scoring scale. SCALE_1 = standard (default for all patients). SCALE_2 = confirmed hypercapnic respiratory failure ONLY. ISO 14971 HAZARD-SPO2-001.

device_vendor.description: Source monitor vendor (for FHIR Device resource).
